In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the membrane-bound NADH oxidoreductase activity of the Eschericia coli respiratory chain, which is inhibited by dicoumarols and other respiratory-chain inhibitors, has been purified to a state of apparent homogeneity.

The main takeaway from our work is that
we have identified a single membrane-bound enzyme in Escherichia coil that catalyzes the transfer of electrons from NADH to the respiratory chain.
the NADH dehydorgenase is the only enzyme in the respiratory chain that has been solubilized and purified.
the NADH dehyrogenase of E. coli can be purified in high yield to a state of homogeneity, and that this is the first example of a purification of an enzyme of the respiratory chain from a bacterium.
